---
title: "Impact of the number of Features"
author: "Léopold Guyot"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
    
---


```{r}
library(scpdata)
library(scp)
```

```{r}
leduc <- scpdata::leduc2022_pSCoPE()
brunner <- scpdata::brunner2022()
```



```{r}
rows <- c()
for (i in seq_along(leduc)) {
    rows <- c(rows, nrow(leduc[[i]]))
}
print(paste0("leduc min: ", median(rows)))

rows <- c()
for (i in seq_along(brunner)) {
    rows <- c(rows, nrow(brunner[[i]]))
}
print(paste0("brunner min: ", median(rows)))
```
